reviews.author: Shaad Nayyar
reviews.text:
IVTC is the only South Indian restaurant at Big Bay, but unfortunately, the food quality is extremely disappointing. I tried the idli, dosa, and vada, and everything was bad, including the chutney and sambar. Even the tea was horrible.

Big Bay management should seriously reconsider having IVTC as its only South Indian food outlet and replace it with a better restaurant that can serve authentic, tasty South Indian food. Customers deserve much better quality and a more satisfying dining experience.

reviews.author: reena khanna
reviews.text:
My experience at Big Bay, Haldiram, and Baskin Robbins was extremely disappointing and unacceptable. The overall hygiene, cleanliness, and food quality were shockingly poor.

The dining area was not clean — tables were sticky, floors looked badly maintained, and the food service area appeared unhygienic and unorganised. Utensils did not look properly cleaned, raising serious concerns about food safety.

The bathroom was dirty and poorly maintained, which further reflected the complete lack of hygiene standards in this place.

The food at Big Bay and Haldiram was bland, tasteless, and poorly prepared, with no freshness or flavour. For the prices charged, this level of food quality is simply not acceptable.

The experience at Baskin Robbins was equally bad. There was no air conditioning, making the outlet uncomfortable, and the ice cream tasted stale, which is extremely concerning for a brand known for desserts.

Overall, this visit was a complete letdown. Unless immediate improvements are made in cleanliness, hygiene, maintenance, and food quality, I would strongly recommend avoiding this place.

reviews.author: Gowtham Thangaraj
reviews.text:
Big Bay India is hands-down one of the most comprehensive and well-maintained highway pitstops I've ever visited. If you are a car traveler or biker needing a rest, this place is absolutely worth the stop.
The selection of dining options is incredible—having Starbucks, KFC, Burger King, and Empire all in one spot means there is something for everyone. Plus, the convenience of the JIO petrol pump right there makes it a one-stop shop for fuel, food, and rest.
What truly sets this pitstop apart are the amenities and cleanliness. The entire area is spotless, the lighting is excellent (great for pictures and selfies!), and the restrooms are incredibly well-maintained. The inclusion of a separate baby room is a huge win for families. There’s even a dedicated smoking area.
The only minor critique is that the service and taste at a few of the restaurants could be improved (though with so many options, you can easily find a good alternative!). Overall, the infrastructure and convenience are top-notch. Highly recommend making this your stop.

reviews.author: SRK NAIR
reviews.text: Hotel Empire is a popular South Indian chain known for both its budget-friendly accommodations and its iconic restaurants, especially in cities like Bangalore. The hotels are generally clean, centrally located, and offer decent service, making them a convenient choice for travelers on a budget. What really sets Empire apart, however, is its restaurant—famous for hearty non-vegetarian fare like shawarma, grilled chicken, and biryani, often served late into the night. While many patrons enjoy the taste and convenience, some branches have received criticism for inconsistent service and hygiene. Overall, Hotel Empire is a reliable option for a quick stay and satisfying meal, especially for night owls and meat lovers.

reviews.author: Soumen DasGupta
reviews.text:
Hands down one of the best highway pitstops along NH 44! Big Bay is massive, clean, and ridiculously well-thought-out. Having so many food options under one roof makes it super convenient when everyone in the car wants something different.
​What really stands out are the ultra-clean, air-conditioned restrooms and the ample parking space. Whether you're pulling over for a quick coffee break, lunch with family, or charging your EV, this place covers all the bases. The kids' area and fuel station right on-site make it a seamless one-stop pause before hitting the road again. A must-visit stop on the Bengaluru–Hyderabad route!

reviews.author: Srikanth RV
reviews.text: A must pitstop if you are on Bangalore - Hyderabad highway. Its like a food court with lot of well known restaurants like Kritunga, Empire, KFC, Pizza hut and many more. From breakfast to lunch to snacks to dinner you get all kinds of things here. Extremely spacious parking and the best part is their washrooms. Very clean and nicely maintained.

reviews.author: Sourabh Das
reviews.text:
On this highway, this is one of the best place to have a break, have snacks/lunch or dinner.
Big Bay is like pitstop of western countries.
Lot of options are available for eating. KFC, Burger King, Starbucks, Empire, Kirtunga, IVTC(Idli, Vada, Tea and Coffee ☺️). Unique name. You get dosa all the time. Also Haldiram's is there for some snacks or breakfast. There is a dry fruit shop, bit expensive though.
Lot of parking space. Beside this, JIO fuel station , if you need to fill your tank.

reviews.author: Ayan Bhattacharya
reviews.text:
While coming back from Bangaluru on NH44 The Big Bay India can be found.

I am sharing the necessary information here, so that you can have a break at the right place.

Cleanliness - 100/100

Parking - Huge parking can accomodate lot of cars

Restroom - Clean & as expected

Wheelchair - Wheelchair compatible way is there

Food - Lot of food options are there, I am amused

Shop - Varities of shops are there where you can have your own window shopping.

Overall the I liked the place very much, highly recommended from my side.

reviews.author: Arun Kumar Singh
reviews.text: This is the best set-up or pitstop on highway, I have ever seen. This place gave me best relaxation or break after long drive on NH44. This has very clean restrooms, ambience to spend some time, and relax. You can enjoy variety of food here from famous brands, for example Burger king, KFC, Haldiram's, Krutunga, Go-Pizza, Leons Burger, Idli Vada Tea/coffee  counters, Starbucks, Ajfan store for some useful items (water bottles/cold drinks), including eatables. Above all it provides nice ambience, something like European Style space. They have very big, and managed free parking space. If you are going towards Hyderabad, then it's worth a wait. From Bengaluru, the Cube stop comes first; however, now I would recommend this place over cube stop. There are some improvement areas as well- at Haldiram's you may not get full menu items. They should have an arrangement for Drinking water. This place looks better in the evenings.

reviews.author: Solomon Sujith
reviews.text:
Big Bay Highway Restaurant, located along NH 44,

- **Facilities**: Big Bay offers a wide range of facilities, including restrooms, drinking water, restaurants, and other outlets. It also has ample parking spaces and areas to sit
- **Food Options**: The food mall provides a variety of multi-cuisine options, including popular brands like Baskin Robbins and pizza
- **Ambiance**: The ambiance is generally pleasant, with clean and air-conditioned restrooms, kids' play areas, and a relaxing environment
- **Convenience**: Big Bay is designed to be a one-stop destination for all travel needs, offering services like EV charging stations, heavy vehicle service, and a fuel station.
- **Overall Experience**: Many travelers appreciate the convenience and variety of services offered at Big Bay, making it a
preferred choice for a highway break

If you're planning a trip along NH 44, Big Bay seems like a great place to take a break and recharge. Safe travels!

reviews.author: Pratik Mohapatra
reviews.text: Big Bay India | Highway Pitstop is a great place to stop for a quick bite or a leisurely meal. The food is fresh and flavorful, and the service is friendly and attentive. The ambiance is also very inviting. However, the prices are a bit on the higher side. I had the Chicken Biryani at Empire Restaurant, and it was absolutely delicious. The service was also excellent. The only downside was that the restaurant was a bit crowded and noisy, so it wasn't the most relaxing atmosphere. Overall, I had a positive experience at Big Bay India Highway Pitstop. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good meal in the area.

reviews.author: Ajay Arora
reviews.text: Excellent stopover place on the highway for food, restrooms, just a break or to spend some time. Very nearly maintained. Food options range from Haldiram, Leon and many more. Ample car parking space. Approach roads are not good/fully ready yet.

reviews.author: Tejaswi Shrivastava
reviews.text: Nice and clean food plaza off Chikballapur right on Bangalore - Hyderabad highway. Lots of food options along with clean & hygienic washrooms. Must visit to refresh and proceed on your journey either way.

reviews.author: Anish Panjwani
reviews.text: Big Bay India Highway Pitstop is a gem for travelers! The ambiance is clean, vibrant, and welcoming, making it the perfect place to relax during a journey. Well known brands such as Halidiram, KFC, Starbucks, Kritunga, Burger king, etc. are available.The food is absolutely delicious, offering a mix of authentic Indian flavors and global options. Service is prompt, and the staff is incredibly friendly and attentive. Ample parking and clean restrooms add to the convenience. Whether you’re looking for a quick snack, a hearty meal, or just a refreshing break, this place has it all. Highly recommend making it your go-to stop!”

reviews.author: TheExplorer
reviews.text: Nice place, have 6 - 8 food brands to eat. In future parking may become an issue. Many shops are yet to open. But it is beautiful and nice for a pit stop. Many items at shops are missing too. I understand it's in progress and will improve soon. But peacefull. Also entry from the highway has to be improved, it's not tar road yet, also it comes all of a sudden so becomes tricky. There is a center area too, but I did not find it useful as shops can be accessed from outside too, and the area doesn't have much sitting space too. The second part is still in construction and may open soon.

reviews.author: Bibekananda Dash
reviews.text:
A much needed refresh point on Bangalore-Hyderabad highway.
Clean washrooms.
Food options - Burger King, Starbucks, Haldiram, Empire, Kritunga, KFC and many more…
Next to this there is also a Jio-BP Petrol pump.
If coming from Hyderabad to Bangalore, U-turn available at short distance.

reviews.author: Shuva Brata Deb
reviews.text:
Excellent put stop for people driving from Bengaluru to Hyderabad or return(requires U turns)

The place is like a small shopping village who look and feel is very American.

Lots of restaurants. Restrooms are clean.

Hope they are able to maintain the quality.

reviews.author: Siddhartha S
reviews.text:
Amazing place for people who love to go on Drives and Rides, Specially on weekends. Good connectivity with city and a moderate distance. Place has decent amenities and parking space. One thing I would suggest if they can extend service operations of food joints in morning hours.

Big Bay pitstop is a very nice initiative👍

reviews.author: Pranurish Zone
reviews.text:
Fantastic Highway Stop Near Chikkaballapur on the Bangalore-Hyderabad Route
This highway stop features numerous well-known brand outlets, including Empire, Starbucks, Haldiram's, KFC, Frozen Bottle, and Burger King, with more brands set to open soon. A spacious lobby is available for those looking to unwind for a bit. The food across all restaurants are good and the washrooms are kept in excellent condition. We also noticed some gift and saree shops.  The restrooms are hygienic and well-maintained, and ample parking space is provided.

reviews.author: Ruchika Gupta
reviews.text:
Stopped by at this place on the way back from
adiyogi. The place is beautiful and neat . But it was raining so toilet floors were wet and messy . There are only 5-6 restaurants . We went to Haldiram, Leon’s and everywhere they had very militia food availability from the menu . Even Starbucks had only 4/5 items . It was surprising to see that not even half the items from the menu were available on Sunday at 8pm in all these restaurants . We finally went to KfC coz they had all the items available . Empire restaurant was good and had a variety of dishes . Taking away 2 stars coz of non availability of dishes . I wish the food court restaurants are better stocked otherwise it defeats the purpose of being an highway food court stop .

reviews.author: Ajay Raj Achary
reviews.text:
Big Bay, India, is a traveler's paradise, tucked away on the Bangalore-Hyderabad Highway (around 90km from Bglr) and very ideal for pit stop. The environment offers a much-needed break from the road, the cuisine selection pleases all palates, and the facilities are immaculate. It is the highest quality, whether you are having a leisurely meal or a fast coffee. Big Bay India sets the bar high for highway stops.

Update 5th Aug 2024 (Second visit) :
On the way back from Lepakshi, we made a lunch break at Big Bay. The space is spacious, tidy, well-kept, and well-organized.
There are numerous culinary selections. Empire was our choice and the food was good.

Parking/Restroom:
There is plenty of room for parking, which is convenient for people who are arriving by bus or car. They even offer a kids' area, EV charging, and a Jio fuel station.
An important consideration for long-distance visitors is the restrooms in Big Bay, which are kept in excellent condition.

Outlets :
Empire, Starbucks, KFC, Burger King, Baskin-Robbins, GoPizza, Leon's, Haldiram’s , Ajfan Dates & Nuts , etc and many more to come .

reviews.text:
Beautiful pitstop.All the food outlets are there.KFC..Burger King..Empire..Haldiram..clean restroom and aesthetic layout for perfect photos.There is a small toyshop as well.
Good place to rest for a while when u r in this highway drive.

reviews.author: Barnita De
reviews.text: We stopped by Big Bay on way back from Le Pakshi for lunch. The place is big, clean, well maintained and organised. There are several food options. We chose Kritunga. Loved the taste of the food. It wasn’t very crowded and that could be because it is recently opened. Once crowd picks up, parking space may turn out to be challenging. Highly recommended place for all travelling through that road

reviews.author: Niharika Ganesh
reviews.text:
Big Bay on NH 44 between Bangalore and Hyderabad offers a well-rounded pit stop experience. The variety of dining options caters to different tastes and dietary preferences, ensuring that every traveler finds something they enjoy. The clean facilities and additional amenities enhance the comfort of the stop, making it a perfect place to take a break during your journey.

For travelers needing to pick up essentials or snacks for the road, the convenience stores here are well-stocked.

Parking: Ample parking space is available, making it convenient for those traveling by car or bus.

The cleanliness and maintenance of the restrooms at the Big bay are commendable, which is a crucial factor for long-distance travelers.

Restaurants: Empire, Starbucks, KFC, BR, Burgers king, Haldiram’s and many more.

reviews.author: Prithviraj Koley
reviews.text:
Big Bay India: A Gem on the Highway

Nestled on the Bangalore-Hyderabad Highway, Big Bay India is a traveler's delight. With its pristine infrastructure and attentive service, it's the ideal pit stop. The facilities are spotless, the food variety caters to all palates, and the ambiance provides a much-needed respite from the road. Whether it's a quick coffee or a leisurely meal, the quality is unmatched. A visit here is not just a break in your journey, but a highlight of it. Big Bay India sets the bar high for highway stops.

reviews.author: MSP ADITYA
reviews.text:
Perfect Highway Pitstop. Highly recommended reststop while long drives.

Easy reach and well maintained.
Has all varieties of food options and also has big enough parking(free) place. Washrooms are clean and veru well maintained.

Staff and owners are also very polite. They even track list items and will save them, one of my friends forget their earbuds here, we were still able to recover them on our next visit after 2 days.

reviews.author: Goutam V
reviews.text: A very nice stop for riders or travellers. Also a great place to chill during  solo ride from Bangalore. It has all the great food spots. Empire, Burger King, Haldirams, Baskin Robins etc. Ample Parking space available.

reviews.author: Mr.D
reviews.text: An absolute gem of a pit stop on the highway! Clean facilities, including well-maintained toilets, make this place a standout. The food options are simply wonderful, catering to various tastes. The ambience is just what you need for a relaxing break on a long drive from Bangalore. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Gemini Man
reviews.text:
I expected that restaurants here would be open 24/7 considering it's on main highway.

At 7am in the morning, only Burger King was open, rest all were closed.

Good place to ride from Bangalore, Ample parking, well planned. Looks high class just what you see abroad.

reviews.author: Maverick Rajiv
reviews.text:
Most of the restaurants were closed when we bikers reached there around 7 in the morning, except Burger king. Even there the staff was less and delay in delivery of orders.

Otherwise it’s an amazing well planned place just that we mostly see overseas. Guess the name itself is inspired from there.

reviews.author: Lydia Solomon
reviews.text: It's an upcoming place but it's done so well. Finally some international standard restrooms and eateries. Lots more shops to come which means it will get more crowded but a great pitstop on route Bangalore to Hyderabad. Would highly recommend going here.

reviews.author: Saranya Prabhu
reviews.text:
Big Bay NH44 is amazing! It's the biggest food mall I've ever seen on the highway! When you're driving and need a break, this place has everything you need. It's like a mini-town under one roof!

The place is huge, like seriously huge - 200,000 square feet huge! And it's super clean, like sparkling clean. You could even take Insta-worthy pics here!

But the best part? The food! They've got all kinds of yummy food - burgers, shakes, you name it. And the restrooms? They're air-conditioned! How cool is that?

Oh, and don't worry about parking - there's plenty of space for your car. Plus, they're putting in charging stations for electric cars soon!

If you're driving on NH44, you gotta stop by Big Bay. Trust me, it's worth it!

reviews.author: Alisha Aizaz
reviews.text: It’s a medium large area, where there are fast food restaurants such as KFC, Leon Grill, Baskin Robbins, Empire, GoPizza, Haldirams, etc. We tired KFC. The food was average in KFC. We tried chicken popcorn, chicken popcorn rice bowl, peri peri fries medium, chicken popcorn large, and spicy mayo dip. The rice bowl was below average. Otherwise the other items were good. We couldn’t try any other restaurants due to lack of time. The pricing was high for the quantity. The place is good as outing and has parking space for both two wheelers and four wheelers.

reviews.author: Jyos Passions
reviews.text:
Recently visited this food mall when we're on the way to Chikkaballapur and I was really amazed by the amenities provided there. Everything at one destination like popular food brands, fuel station, stunning restrooms, huge car parking, lounge area, kids play area etc. This mall is quite aesthetically designed & love the peaceful atmosphere.

Big Bay is a fabulous destination if you wanna relish some good food or looking for a place to stretch your legs during a road trip

And also it's a great getaway from Bangalore if you are looking for a long car drive or motorcycle ride.

Highly recommended !!

reviews.author: Rehan Akhtar
reviews.text:
Awesome place. Must visit if you like long drives and good food. We have multiple options veg, non veg, coffee, ice cream, etc ...

Big Bay is a popular highway pitstop located on NH44, the Bangalore-Hyderabad highway. It's a great place to take a break during your journey, offering a variety of amenities and services.

Dining Options: You'll find a range of restaurants and cafes, including popular chains and local eateries

Facilities: The pitstop is equipped with clean restrooms, ample parking space, and areas to sit and relax.

Shopping: There are several stores where you can shop for snacks, souvenirs, and other travel essentials

Kid-Friendly: It has facilities like ice cream parlors and play areas to keep children entertained

It's an ideal spot to refresh and recharge before continuing your journey.

reviews.author: Wonder Boy - Siddhant
reviews.text:
It’s recently opened food mall on Bangalore- Hyderabad highway with lots of eatery options like Starbucks,Haldirams, Burger King, KFC,Leons Ajfan and many more
50% of the shops are yet to occupy.
Good thing is earlier there was no good food option if you are visiting for a day outing to Lepakshi

reviews.author: Abhilash Pradhan
reviews.text: Big Bay India Food Mall is a welcome oasis along the highway, offering a plethora of dining options amidst a stretch devoid of alternatives. From international chains like Burger King, Starbucks, KFC, and Baskin Robbins to local favorites such as Empire Restaurant and GoPizza, there's something to satiate every palate. The inclusion of clean and well-equipped toilet facilities, along with a refueling station, makes it a convenient pitstop for travelers. The design exudes the charm of a well-maintained food street, with ample parking space ensuring hassle-free access. reviews.author: Canakapalli Bhaskar
reviews.text: Very beautiful and relaxing pitstop. Wife variety of restaurants to choose from. Very clean toilets and ample parking. This is a new place and I hope Big Bay India will maintain it like this always. I for one was very impressed.

reviews.author: Naresh Kareti
reviews.text: A must pitstop to relax on the highway. It has all major branded food courts like starbucks, kfc, burger king, ajfan, B&R, toys, Leon burgers etc.. All the good options at one place. Washrooms are super clean and hope they maintain the same way at all times. Dont forget to stop here of you are travelling on this highway.

reviews.author: Pravin Varma
reviews.text:
A well laid out food arena by the side of Bengaluru Hyderabad National Highway with varied choices for all age group and taste buds viz. KFC, Haldiram, Empire, Baskin Robbins, Burger King, Starbucks, Leon, Go Pizza etc.
Lot many other good fast food/drink joints are also available.
Restrooms are kept very clean and tidy.
Lot many photo points.
Ample parking is available for four and two wheelers.
Jio petrol pump is next to Big Bay.
Overall a nice place to take a break with family and friends.

reviews.author: Ajay Morla
reviews.text:
Very scenic view with plenty of options to eat and spend time.
It has spacious parking lot and very clean washrooms.
A nice place for people who want to have a quick bite at a hygienic place.
Will recommend the same for highway travellers.

reviews.author: sanath kumar
reviews.text: A very good place on the highway NH 44 to take a stop, it has all the required facilities from restrooms, drinking water, restaurants and other outlets. It has good parking spaces, and places to sit and stretch.

reviews.author: Shiv Chuni
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience at this petrol pump with a fantastic range of restaurant options and top-notch washroom facilities.

The variety of restaurant choices in this food court made it easy to find something for each one of us in a group of 4, and the overall atmosphere was very hygienic, extremely aesthetically appealing and welcoming.

We had an assortment of food from Haldirams, KFC, Burger King, Starbucks  and Empire. I have traveled the length and breath of India and have seen very few if none matching this standard

The cleanliness and upkeep of the washrooms were impressive and best in class – akin more to 5 star hotels than petrol bunks on the highway,  providing a level of comfort and convenience not found at petrol stations/restaurants in India.

We also filled fuel here and the staff was very pleasant and courteous to deal with.

I highly recommend this to anyone passing by for fuel and food.

Wish there were more options like this on all highways. It would make life simpler.

reviews.author: Noushad K
reviews.text: Big Bay, situated on Hyderabad Road, is a great place for dining. Most of the popular restaurant brands are available here, giving plenty of options to choose from. The ambiance is good, the place is spacious, and it’s suitable for families and groups. Overall, a nice spot to enjoy different cuisines under one roof. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Soumen Bhattacharjee
reviews.text:
This is a refreshment zone beside the Bangalore-Hyderabad highway. It has few big brand restaurants like starbucks, burger king, empire, baskin robins etc. Also it has toy shop and few more small shops. It’s a well maintained and beautiful soothing place. Even restrooms are very clean. It looks amazing during evening with plenty of parking area. If you are going that way, you must stop and experience it. Also if you are looking for a drive destination from Bangalore, give this place a try.

Have a safe drive!

reviews.text: Need a restroom :p, come here. Besides that Starbucks, Burger king is there. Many other shops opening up.

reviews.author: Mohammed Jawad
reviews.text:
On September 6th, during my visit to Big Bay, I noticed that a few restaurants were still undergoing construction. The only dining options available at the time were KFC and Gopizza, both of which had limited operating hours. Nevertheless, it proved to be a tranquil and serene spot to unwind after a lengthy drive.

Big Bay boasts ample parking space, which is a convenient feature for visitors. Unfortunately, during my visit, restroom facilities were unavailable. Nonetheless, despite this inconvenience, I managed to have a peaceful and enjoyable time at Big Bay.
